items.name: Westminster ennen paloa
items.note: Pääsali tunnistettava; takasiivet ja pihat tulkittu liian säännöllisiksi.

qa.scopeLabel: Approximate prefire reconstruction, with unresolved court and concealed-wing topology; not an exact historical survey.
matches: The huge elongated steep Hall roof, small ridge lantern and modest end pinnacles agree with W3; the Hall is the dominant single roof mass.
The low classical frontage beside castellated Gothic ranges broadly preserves the hierarchy visible in W3/W4/W6. No modern Parliament towers are introduced.
discrepancies: The candidate resolves the south/east and rear portion into large, fairly regular high enclosing ranges and rectangular courts. W1 instead has a much more fragmented sequence of differently sized chambers, passages and courts; a reliable one-to-one correspondence of the candidate courts to W1 cannot be established from this view. This is a main-plan uncertainty, not merely missing ornament.

The tall unified back-right perimeter and its connected roof runs are visually stronger and more regular than the irregular small rooms and offsets recorded in W1. These visible reconstructed volumes are not supported as exact as-built geometry by W3/W4/W5/W6, which show only selected frontages.

The Old Palace Yard Gothic frontage is compressed and regularized: W6 shows a long taller central Gothic block with distinct rectangular end/projection hierarchy; the candidate divides the visible frontage into repeated castellated projections.
recommendations: Retain only as a WARN owner-review reconstruction. Before whole-building modeling, trace W1 and identify Hall, St Stephens Chapel, House of Lords, Speakers Court and each major open court on the candidate footprint.
Do not present the rear ranges or court arrangement as confirmed historic fact; resolve the plan hierarchy before any Tripo approval.

items.name: Kärntnertorin portti
items.note: Portin harjakoriste liian korkealla; sillan kaaria yksinkertaistettu.

qa.scopeLabel: Approximate old city gate and isolated wall/bridge fragment, not a theatre or the separate New Kärntnertor.
matches: The candidate correctly makes a decorated round-arched tunnel through a substantial battered wall, with lower rectangular side portals, matching reference 1.
The forward bridge-like approach and massive wall relationship agree broadly with oblique reference 3.
discrepancies: The central obelisk/crest projects conspicuously above the wall coping in the candidate. In reference 1 its tip remains at about the wall top, and reference 3 also places the ornament against the taller wall rather than as a freestanding skyline spike.

Reference 3 shows a comparatively thin bridge deck with shallow arched span undersides and tall slender piers. The candidate has a much heavier solid deck, rectangular flat-bottomed gaps and squat block-like supports, changing a major visible silhouette.

The photograph of the city side (reference 2) records a high curved central brick parapet and a distinctly different portal composition. The generated front-only view does not expose or verify that reverse side; the flat wall top cannot be accepted as proof of the inner portal.
recommendations: For any later authorized replacement, lower the field-side crest relative to wall coping and reproduce the shallow arched bridge span silhouette from reference 3.
Keep wall depth, tunnel section and reverse portal explicitly unresolved. A reverse-view/source check is needed before approving a complete 3D object.

items.name: Porto di Ripetta
items.note: Päämuoto vastaa lähteitä. Suihkulähde ja askelmat yksinkertaistettu.

qa.scopeLabel: Broad main-form pass against the Specchi prints, with approximate minor details; not certified as-built geometry.
matches: The candidate is a low open quay rather than a roofed building, with a broad shallow horizontal footprint.
The central convex upper platform, mirrored concave transitions and broad straight lateral stair runs agree with the controlling small plan in R1 and the river elevation/perspective in R1/R2.
The overall stepped silhouette and low central parapet remain clearly legible and broadly source-consistent.
discrepancies: The fountain is simplified into a small basin with a tall rounded slab on the upper terrace, set behind the curved parapet. R2 shows a more sculptural central feature closely integrated with the river-facing central parapet; the candidate changes this small feature and its placement.
The candidate central parapet and stair bands are cleaner, thicker and more uniformly regular than the prints. Exact riser/landing count is not verified.
The long straight rear boundary and side-return walls are isolation closures, not geometry demonstrated in full by these prints.
recommendations: Suitable for owner review at approximate main-mass level, retaining the stated reconstruction limitation.
Correct the fountain placement/form if detail fidelity is required; do not infer exact dimensions, buried construction or an as-built rear boundary from this image.

items.name: Palais de l’Industrie — 1854 suunnitelma
items.note: Suunnitelmaan perustuva kuva; ei varmistus toteutuneesta katosta.

qa.scopeLabel: 1854 contemporary DESIGN-based reconstruction; this pass does not certify the completed historical building or final roof.
matches: The elongated low rectangular stone perimeter and two storeys of repeated round-arched openings agree broadly with the I2 plan and I3 design perspective.
A long high central longitudinal vault sits above lower parallel side vaults, preserving the essential three-vault hierarchy in I2/I3.
The central monumental round entrance arch, paired column groups, projecting upper block and crown sculpture broadly agree with the entrance motif photographed in I4.
The corners remain modest projecting rectangular pavilions, without added domes or monumental towers.
discrepancies: The roof section is smoothed into regular rounded barrels. I2/I3 show a more articulated/peaked ridge and roof break at the apex, so the candidate simplifies the uppermost section silhouette.
The entrance and repeated facade bays are regularized; the actual I4 ground-level portal subdivision and adjacent opening pattern are not reproduced exactly.
The hidden rear and precise plan ratios cannot be measured reliably from this perspective; no complete as-built roof/rear evidence is established by the reference set.
recommendations: Use only under an explicit 1854 design-based label. Do not promote it as proof of the final built roof.
If section fidelity is required, refine the central and side roof apex profile to I2/I3; preserve the current correct three-vault hierarchy.

items.name: Heinrichshof
items.note: Pääjulkisivu ja kulmat tuettu. Sisäpihan ja takasivun muoto arvio.

qa.summary: Recognizable long Heinrichshof street block; no material contradiction in the documented principal mass.
observedMatches: Long continuous facade and return, broad raised central pavilion, compact attached raised corner pavilions and lower connecting roof ranges correspond to H1/H2/H3.
Arched ground storey, dense upper bay rhythm and relative main-storey heights are retained.

issues.detail: The chosen view exposes a rear inner-facing band but does not clearly expose the courtyard floor or full rear roof/court closure. A hollow court and its exact layout cannot be certified from this image or the supplied street sources.
Inner/rear facade, chimney repetition and far-side roof junctions are interpreted; H1/H2/H3 do not document them.

qa.scope: Intact historical Heinrichshof principal facade and visible corner/return; rear/courtyard interpretation remains qualified.

items.name: Altes Burgtheater — pieni vanha teatteri
items.note: Pieni teatteri tunnistettava; piilossa oleva takaosa arvioitu.

qa.summary: Correct small old theatre identity, with the adjoining domed palace excluded.
observedMatches: B1 small right-hand two-storey facade is preserved: three principal upper windows, taller curved central bay, balcony, blind lower panels and rounded right corner with window.
Small standalone mass and grey hipped roof remain consistent with the small piece in B3; no palace wings or giant dome.

issues.detail: The isolated rear boundary, rectangular depth and three small side-window bays are not established by B1. B3 is a secondary city model and cannot independently certify the hidden theatre/stage footprint.
Roof rise and simplified finials are approximated; B1 roof and rear are partly occluded. The lower blind panels are visible in B1 and are not treated as a missing-door failure.

qa.scope: Only the small Altes Burgtheater at Michaelerplatz, not the large neighbouring palace or new Ringstrasse Burgtheater.

items.name: Kärntnertortheater — teatteri
items.note: Pääjulkisivu ja korkea katto tuettu. Takaosa ja tarkka syvyys arvio.

qa.summary: Correct theatre mass and photographic front-pavilion/main-roof relationship.
observedMatches: K1 projecting low three-bay facade, paired upper-storey window rows, canopy/ground entrances, crest and statues are present.
A substantially taller deep theatre body with steep hipped roof rises behind; no city gate, gate passage, dome or Staatsoper substitution.
Long side has the plain repeated-window body and low side entrance projection seen in K1.

issues.detail: Rear end closure, exact building depth, dormer distribution and some side bays are inferred; neither supplied source establishes a measured complete footprint.
Canopy supports, statuary and entrance/step details are simplified. K4 is a different retrospective depiction and does not override K1 photographic mass.

qa.scope: K1 photograph controls the historical theatre; K4 only secondary support. Not the Kärntnertor gate.

items.name: Les Halles — yksi paviljonki
items.note: Yksi Baltardin paviljonkityyppi, ei koko Les Halles -kokonaisuus.

qa.summary: Coherent single Baltard-type pavilion; accepted one-pavilion scope respected.
observedMatches: Single rectangular complete exterior, low broad lower roof, raised clerestory and smaller upper lantern roof follow H1/H2 central pavilion hierarchy.
Thin iron framing, arched/shuttered repeated wall panels, pale plinth and metal roofing correspond to H2/H4.
No exposed cutaway/basement, adjacent street portals, Saint-Eustache, dome or invented full-complex completion.

issues.detail: Repeated facade bays are regularized rather than a literal elevation copy: the generated long face has about ten broad panels, while the H2 central pavilion between portals shows about eight. Exact pavilion number and bay count are therefore not certified.
Complete short-end closure, door locations and hidden roof junctions are interpreted from a pavilion type; the three supplied sources do not fix one numbered pavilion in a measured plan.

qa.scope: ONE pavilion only; absence of the rest of Les Halles is accepted scope, not a QA failure. completedWholeComplex=false.

items.name: Newgate — vuoden1800 kuvalaatan tulkinta
items.note: Yksi johdonmukainen piirrosvaihe. Ei väitettä toteutuneesta muodosta.

qa.summary: Internally coherent N2 plate interpretation with the principal three-court arrangement retained.
observedMatches: Long sparse-window rusticated frontage, central pedimented keeper-house and two lower projecting flanking entries closely follow N2 elevation.
Three open court groups are visible; central group projects farther to the rear, and the central front chapel/ward roof volumes occupy the court edge rather than filling the entire void.
No medieval gate, towers, dome, fully roofed slab or conflicting alternative footprint introduced.

issues.detail: N2 plan establishes room/court layout but not these rear roof profiles, interior-facing window elevations or all heights. Those parts remain architectural interpretation.

N2 room partitions, unequal side-court depths and small staircase/closet projections are simplified into broad perimeter ranges. This is a massing interpretation, not a measured room-by-room reconstruction.
Published-1800 N2 plate-only comparison does not prove that this exact scheme was built or identify a later constructed phase. No as-built claim is made.

qa.scope: N2 published-1800 elevation-and-plan plate ONLY. No N1/N3 comparison or as-built inference.

rootSourceQA: independent agent compared all24 actual refs; root reviewed overview and reports
completedWholeComplexException: Les Halles is one pavilion, not complete complex
rootSheetVisualQA: PASS: layout and original candidates reviewed; historical caveats retained
